title: Artifice Ales & Mead

blurb: Guests visit the taproom to enjoy craft beer, mead, and food with international influences. The brewery crafts beer and mead in small batches on location, focusing on authentic styles and local ingredients. They also offer event space for small to medium gatherings.
extraNote: No reservations for parties less than 10 · Dogs not permitted inside or on patio; table on grass available · Taproom at Artifice Ales & Mead, Manheim, PA
